data.name: Bagsy
data.detailed_description:
Dive into the colorful and captivating world of Bagsy, an infiltration game where cunning and strategy are your best weapons! Take on the role of a daring thief whose goal is to steal carefully guarded treasures from a variety of shops and banks.

Dynamic Infiltration!

Explore around 50 meticulously designed levels, each set during the day or at night. Each environment presents unique challenges based on the time chosen by the developers.

Specific Objectives!

Your mission is to steal the cash register from the shop or the vault from the bank. Focus on your goal while navigating the obstacles in your path.

Puzzles and Obstacles!

Solve clever puzzles and overcome various challenges to access your loot. Each level will test your ingenuity.

Quick Escape!

If you get spotted, act fast! You have a few minutes to escape before the police arrive. Use your environment to get out of tricky situations.

Diversion Mechanisms!

Create distractions to fool the guards and customers, making your stealthy approach easier.

Colorful Cartoon Graphics!

Enjoy a vibrant visual style that makes each level fun and engaging, creating a playful and immersive atmosphere.

An Accessible Adventure!

Whether you're a novice or an expert, Bagsy offers a learning curve suitable for everyone. Get ready to tackle stimulating challenges while having fun in this joyful and dynamic universe.

Join Bagsy in this thrilling adventure and show that you are the ultimate thief!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400/AMD FX-8320
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 /AMD Radeon RX 5700
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-9750H CPU @ 2.60GHz 2.59 GHz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3070 /AMD Radeon RX 6750 XT
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
